In the interim, until Atko sets up the ability to make subs text only or link only, I found a way to set it with css.

.tabmenu li:nth-child(4){

display: none;

}

Set 3 to make it links only, and 4 to make it text only.

Edit: it hides it from the frontpage of the sub, but it shows it when you click the not-hidden link. e.g. having submit link hidden, when you click submit a message, it will show submit a link. Ideas to get around that?

edit 2: with this new update (css applied to submit pages), this works to restrict to link only/text only. yay.
